pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo aciravatiyā nadiyā vesiyāhi saddhiṃ naggā ekatitthe nahāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.4: kinnu kho nāma ayye tumhākaṃ daharānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciṇṇena nanu nāma kāmā paribhuñjitabbā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.5: yadā jiṇṇā bhavissatha tadā brahmacariyaṃ carissatha
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.6: evaṃ tumhākaṃ ubho atthā pariggahitā bhavissantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.8: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo upassayaṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.11: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.12: tenahi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.16.1: yā pana bhikkhunī naggā nahāyeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:2.1.6: anivatthā vā apārutā vā nahāyati payoge dukkaṭaṃ
